annotations.title: Set my unsubscribe page name and provider webhooks

description: Set your unsubscribe-list's page name (site_name), the inbox for suppression events, and the bounce and complaint webhooks of your providers: resend {signing_secret}, sendgrid {public_key}, ses {topic_arn}, postmark true (null turns resend, sendgrid or ses off; postmark false). The answer has each provider's webhook_url; Postmark's Basic auth password is shown only when you turn it on.

inbox_instance_id.description: One of your owner's webhook inboxes for suppression events (null: none).

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

postmark.description: true turns on Postmark's webhook (the answer shows its Basic auth password; send true again to see it again); false turns it off.

signing_secret.description: The whsec_... signing secret of your Resend webhook.

resend.description: Resend's bounce and complaint webhook; null turns it off.

public_key.description: The verification key of SendGrid's Signed Event Webhook.

sendgrid.description: SendGrid's Signed Event Webhook; null turns it off.

topic_arn.description: The ARN of the SNS topic of your SES bounces and complaints (arn:aws:sns:...).

ses.description: Amazon SES through an SNS topic; null turns it off.

site_name.description: The name your unsubscribe page shows (a plain name, null clears it).
